title: Crypto Trading Signals - May 07, 2026
top_story_headline: Bitcoin lenders say institutions are abandoning risky DeFi credit models in favor of TradFi-style crypto lending with transparent custody, standardized structures, and stricter risk controls
top_story_comment: This shift aligns with BTC's consolidation above $60k support. Institutional players prefer regulated frameworks, especially when volatility spikes. DeFi lending TVL at $45B shows resilience, but TradFi's growth suggests a bifurcated market. Watch BTC's reaction at $62k - lose that and DeFi liquidations could accelerate. Break $65k with volume and both models benefit.
